steps.title: Determine First Player
text: Randomly determine who goes first. The winner chooses to play or draw.
Use any mutually agreeable random method (dice roll, coin flip). The winner decides whether to play first or draw first.

steps.title: Shuffle & Draw
text: Each player shuffles their library and draws 7 cards as their opening hand.
Thoroughly randomize your deck. Your opponent may shuffle or cut it after you finish.
Both players draw 7 cards from the top of their library.

steps.title: Mulligan (London Mulligan)
text: Draw 7 each time. After keeping, put 1 card on the bottom of your library for each mulligan taken.
Starting with the first player, each player may declare a mulligan: shuffle your hand back into your library and draw 7 new cards.
After you keep a hand, put 1 card from it on the bottom of your library for each mulligan you took. You may mulligan as many times as you want.

steps.title: Choose Your Commander
text: Each player reveals their legendary creature commander and places it in the command zone.
Your commander must be a legendary creature (or a planeswalker allowed by the rules). It starts in the command zone, not in your library.
Your deck's color identity is determined by all mana symbols in your commander's mana cost and rules text. Every card in your 99-card library must fall within this color identity.

steps.title: Determine Turn Order
text: Randomly determine seating. The first player chooses the direction of play.
Commander is typically played with 4 players. Determine seating randomly, then the player going first chooses whether play proceeds clockwise or counterclockwise.
Each player starts with 40 life. Commander damage is tracked separately for each commander (21+ combat damage from a single commander = loss).

steps.title: Shuffle & Draw
text: Shuffle your 99-card library. Draw 7 cards, then take mulligans as desired.
Thoroughly shuffle your deck. Opponents may cut. Draw 7 cards. London Mulligan applies: shuffle back, draw 7 again, bottom 1 card per mulligan taken.

steps.title: Choose Your Commander
text: Each player reveals their legendary creature (or planeswalker) commander and places it in the command zone.
Duel Commander uses the same color identity rules as regular Commander. Your commander starts in the command zone. Both players start with 20 life.

steps.title: Determine First Player
text: Randomly determine who goes first. The winner chooses to play or draw.
Use any mutually agreeable random method. The winner decides whether to play first or draw first.

steps.title: Shuffle & Draw
text: Shuffle your 99-card library. Draw 7 cards. London Mulligan: shuffle back, draw 7, bottom 1 per mulligan.
Thoroughly shuffle your deck. Draw 7. Mulligan as many times as you want, bottoming 1 card per mulligan.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: The most recent 3 years of premiere Standard-legal Magic sets. Older sets rotate out annually.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: All sets from Eighth Edition (July 2003) forward, plus Modern Horizons sets. Does not rotate.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: All sets from Return to Ravnica (October 2012) forward. Non-rotating format between Standard and Modern.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: All Magic sets ever printed. Has its own banned list separate from other formats. No restricted list.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: All Magic sets ever printed. Uses a Restricted List — restricted cards are limited to 1 copy instead of 4. Only format with restricted cards.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: Sets from Fourth Edition and Ice Age (1995) through Scourge (2003). Community-run format focused on the pre-Modern era.

steps.title: Deck — Card Pool
text: Only cards printed at common rarity in any Magic set or product. If a card was ever common, all versions are legal.

steps.title: Deck — Deck Size
text: Minimum 60 cards, no maximum.

steps.title: Deck — Card Limit
text: Max 4 copies of any card with the same English name. Basic lands (Plains, Island, Swamp, Mountain, Forest) are unlimited. Cards that override this (like Relentless Rats) take precedence.

steps.title: Deck — Sideboard
text: Up to 15 cards. After game 1, swap cards on a 1-for-1 basis. Deck must stay at least 60 cards after sideboarding.

steps.title: Deck — Deck Size
text: Exactly 100 cards including your commander. 99 cards in the library + 1 commander in the command zone.

steps.title: Deck — Singleton
text: Only 1 copy of any card except basic lands or cards that specifically say otherwise.

steps.title: Deck — Commander
text: 1 legendary creature as your commander. Starts in the command zone. Color identity = all mana symbols on your commander — every card must match.
Cast from command zone any time you could cast a sorcery. Commander tax: +2 generic mana per previous cast from command zone.

steps.title: Deck — Starting Life
text: 40 life. 21+ combat damage from a single commander = loss, tracked per commander.

steps.title: Deck — Deck Size
text: Exactly 100 cards including commander. Singleton: 1 copy per card except basic lands.

steps.title: Deck — Commander
text: 1 legendary creature or planeswalker (per banlist). Color identity rules same as Commander. Commander tax: +2 per recast.

steps.title: Deck — Starting Life
text: 20 life. 21 commander damage rule applies. 1v1 format with a separate banlist from multiplayer Commander.
**Battlefield (Standard)**
bullets: **Hand** — Cards you hold. Hidden. Max 7 at end of turn.
**Battlefield** — Permanents (creatures, lands, artifacts, enchantments, planeswalkers). Each player has their own side.
**Stack** — Spells and abilities wait to resolve here. Last-in, first-out.

text: **Battlefield (Commander, 4 Players)**
bullets: **Battlefield** — All 4 players share the battlefield with their own sides.
**Command Zone** — Commander starts here. Cast from here with commander tax (+2 per recast).

text: **Battlefield (Duel Commander, 1v1)**
bullets: **Battlefield** — 1v1, each player has their own side.
**Command Zone** — Commander starts here. Commander tax applies. 20 starting life.
